TOYRAM
Primitive: Toy block memory with a long title that wraps onto
a second line

    PRIMITIVE_GROUP: BLOCKRAM
    PRIMITIVE_SUBGROUP: BRAM

Introduction
Toy text for layout tests.


Port Descriptions

          Port           Direction         Width                            Function
ADDRA<15:0>              Input         16          Toy address bus.
ADDRB <13:0>             Input         14          Toy second address bus.
                                                   Toy clock. Edge set by an
CLKA                     Input         1
                                                   inversion attribute.
                                                   Toy output bus. Only valid when
DOA[31:0]                Output        32          the toy mode is set and the
                                                   toy enable is High.
Q1 - Q2                  Output        1           Toy paired outputs.
CE1, CE2                 Input         1           Toy paired enables.
SHIFTIN1 / SHIFTIN2      Input         1           Toy cascade inputs.
D1 : D2                  Input         1 (each)    Toy paired data.
INTERNAL_TCK             Internal      1           Toy other-family pin.

TOYSER
Primitive: Toy deserializer

    PRIMITIVE_GROUP: I/O
    PRIMITIVE_SUBGROUP: SERDES

Port Descriptions

           Port          Direction       Width                                Function
                                                  Toy slip first line that runs on over
                                                  several lines while the row name sits
TSLIP                    Input       1            in the middle of the cell as the pdf
                                                  renderer centres it vertically on the
                                                  row (toy ends here).
                                                  Toy enable module first line.
                                                  module.
                                                  •   When toy is one, the second input is not
                                                      used at all by the toy.
                                                      and so on for the toy.
                                                  •   When toy is two, both inputs are used,
                                                      with the first input for half a
TCE1, TCE2               Input       1                cycle, and the second for the other half.
                                                      The toy module converts two to one and
                                                      is clocked by the toy divided clock and
                                                      is needed for toy memory interfaces
                                                      in toy mode.
                                                  •   When the toy attribute is two, both
                                                      ports are available.
                                                  •   When toy is one, only the first is
                                                      a regular clock enable.
                                                  The toy high-speed clock input clocks in
TCLK                     Input       1
                                                  the toy data stream.
                                                  Toy divided clock with a five line
                                                  cell whose last line is a single word
TDIV                     Input       1            on its own line so that the cell is
                                                  longer below the row than above
                                                  it.
TSEL                     Input       1            Toy select.
                                                  toy lowercase start that cannot be
TODD                     Input       1
                                                  resolved.
